jessica_pm: Heads up  we're iterating on dedicated autoscale policy table. Need to pick a default burst admission rule for GA.

omar_eng: Current candidates: 'allow-burst-until-credit' (enforce token bucket), 'preemptible-burst' (allow bursts but preempt best-effort tenants), or 'strict-fairshare' (no bursts; requests subject to fairshare immediately).

ravi_sre: For oncall and system stability, preemptible-burst worries me unless we have good eviction metrics. Preemptions at tail latency are a real customer-facing risk.

maria_cs: Customers running real-time features care about p99 latency. They prefer deterministic behavior: either you have a burst guarantee, or you don't. Unclear if preemption will be acceptable.

jessica_pm: Suggest default = allow-burst-until-credit + preemptible-burst as opt-in vendor setting for internal tenants/partners. We'll market preemptible-burst as lower-cost option.

omar_eng: Implementation gap: admission controller needs to check both tenant credits and preemption class. Also needs to tag requests with 'preemptible=true' so runtime can pick scheduling lane.

ravi_sre: Monitor: burst-preemptions/sec, p99 latency by tenant, eviction-counts. Runbook: if preemption rate > 1/min sustained for 5m escalate.

jessica_pm: Launch criteria: default policy in Console, associated docs, and GA telemetry. Also need clear wording for SLA disclaimers.

maria_cs: Can product own messaging that tells customers what happens when credits are used up? A simple diagram in Console would help.

omar_eng: We'll add a UI state machine: Active -> BurstUsing -> BurstDepleted -> Throttled. And emit events for each transition.

deploy-bot: deployment complete: autoscale/policy-service -> staging (omar_eng)

jessica_pm: Action items: omar_eng: PR with policy-service changes (Thu). ravi_sre: instrumentation + runbook (Fri). maria_cs: example customer messaging + Console mockups (next Tue).

maria_cs: One more ask  make default credits per tenant small (30s) to avoid occupancy explosion at GA. We can tune with pilots.

jessica_pm: Agreed. We'll start conservative. Thanks all.
